cohort: The study involved 5,628 patients comparing pregnancies achieved through IVF/ICSI with those conceived naturally.
finding: The IVF/ICSI group showed significantly higher rates of placental adherence, postpartum hemorrhage, and preterm delivery, along with lower neonatal gestational age and reduced birth weight compared to natural pregnancies.
birth_weight: IVF/ICSI group: 3159.42 +/- 722.75 g; Natural pregnancy group: 3211.31 +/- 624.42 g
gest_age: IVF/ICSI group: 38.21 +/- 2.12 weeks; Natural pregnancy group: 38.63 +/- 2.29 weeks
